create_mesh_grid: create a batched mesh grid tensor of shape Bx2xHxW for given batch size, height, and width
build_flow_warp: build a flow warping function that applies optical flow to an image tensor using bilinear grid sampling
test_occ_mask_bidirection: test bidirectional occlusion mask computation from forward and backward optical flows
test_occ_mask_backward: test backward occlusion mask generation from a single optical flow using correspondence mapping
create_corresponding_map: create a bilinear correspondence map from unnormalized coordinate tensors of shape Bx2xHxW
